method.reason_support_definition: Reason truth is evaluated against complete frozen source, with exact cited facts and independent calculations retained. Missing cited operands remain failures even where the reason is truthful; every_linked_reason_supported is not a substitute for required operand sufficiency. No fictitious reason was found.
method.primary_invalid_policy: All five primary atomic judgment fields are null for every atom in a mechanically invalid position. Raw diagnosis is independent supplementary review, never salvage, and changes no gate.
method.conservative_abstention_policy: No allowed clean abstentions observed.
